app.description: Move Python code from google-generativeai and vertexai.generative_models to google-genai, keeping comments and formatting. Prints a diff by default; nothing is written without --write.
app.epilog: A file is migrated completely or not at all: if a spot cannot be followed safely, the file stays untouched and the spot is listed. Check the result with: genai-py-codemod verify OLD.py NEW.py
arg.paths: files or directories to migrate (directories are searched recursively for *.py)
arg.write: write the migrated code back to the files (default: print a diff only)
arg.check: exit with status 1 if any file would change or any spot needs a manual look (for CI); implies no diff output
arg.api_version: API version handling: auto pins v1beta only for -latest/-preview/-exp models, keep always pins the old SDK's version, none never pins
arg.lang: language of messages: en or ko (default: GENAI_PY_CODEMOD_LANG, then LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG, else en)
verify.description: Run two files against mocked transports (no key, no network) and compare the API requests they send. Exit 0 = same requests, 1 = different, 2 = could not run.
verify.before: file written for the old SDK (run with --old-python)
verify.old_python: interpreter that has the old SDK installed (default: the current interpreter)
verify.new_python: interpreter that has google-genai installed (default: the current interpreter)
verify.strict: treat an API version difference (for example v1beta -> v1) as a failure instead of a warning
verify.timeout: seconds to wait for each file to finish (default: 60)
verify.mock_notice: mock transport: only the requests are compared, no real model output is checked
verify.nothing: nothing to compare: neither file sent an API request. Pass entry-point scripts that run to the end and call the API (a module that only defines functions sends nothing); add a small call at the bottom, or verify a script that uses it.
verify.hint.old-sdk: install the old SDK where the file runs: pip install "genai-py-codemod[verify]", or point --old-python at an interpreter that has google-generativeai (or google-cloud-aiplatform)
verify.hint.new-sdk: install the new SDK where the file runs: pip install "genai-py-codemod[verify]", or point --new-python at an interpreter that has google-genai
verify.error.missing-file: {path} does not exist; pass the path of a Python file
verify.error.interpreter-not-found: interpreter not found: {python}; pass a working --old-python/--new-python
verify.error.timeout: {path} did not finish within {seconds}s; verify a smaller entry-point file or raise --timeout
verify.error.no-result:
running {path} with {python} failed before any result was written:
{detail}
verify.error.script-exit: {path} exited with status {status} under {python}; verify needs a script that runs to the end without sys.exit(error)
verify.error.sdk-missing:
{path} could not import a module under {python} (is the SDK installed in this interpreter?):
{detail}
verify.error.network-blocked:
{path} tried to open a network connection under {python}; verify blocks all connections, so the script must not need the network apart from the Gemini SDK calls:
{detail}
help.help: show this help message and exit
msg.missing_path: path does not exist: {path}; pass a file or a directory
msg.parse_error: {path}:{line}: cannot parse ({message}); fix the syntax error and run again
msg.read_error: {path}: cannot read ({detail}); the file must be UTF-8 or declare its encoding (# coding: ...), convert it to UTF-8 and run again
msg.write_check_conflict: --write and --check cannot be used together; use --check in CI and --write when migrating
summary.dry_run: {changed} file(s) would change, {manual} spot(s) need a manual look, {info} note(s); {scanned} file(s) scanned. Re-run with --write to apply.
summary.written: {changed} file(s) changed, {manual} spot(s) need a manual look, {info} note(s); {scanned} file(s) scanned.
summary.check: {changed} file(s) would change automatically, {manual} spot(s) need a manual look; {scanned} file(s) scanned.
finding.handle-escapes: the model or chat object is passed on, returned, stored or used in another way; left unchanged because the receiver would get a model name string
finding.handle-reassigned: the variable is assigned more than once, so it cannot be followed; left unchanged
finding.handle-untracked: model object is not stored in a plain variable or used right away; left unchanged
finding.call-kwargs: *args/**kwargs are passed; the arguments cannot be mapped, left unchanged
finding.call-args: an argument without an equivalent in google-genai (or used in an unexpected way); left unchanged
finding.call-config-merge: generation settings are given both on the model and on the call; google-genai needs one merged config, left unchanged
finding.config-dynamic: the configuration is not a literal dict or a GenerationConfig(...) call; left unchanged
finding.callable-tools-afc: tools contain Python callables; google-genai runs them automatically by default, so decide on automatic_function_calling by hand
finding.tools-unsupported: this tool is not converted automatically; left unchanged
finding.tool-config: tool_config has no automatic conversion; left unchanged
finding.count-tokens-semantics: count_tokens on a model with system_instruction or tools counts differently in google-genai; left unchanged
finding.async-chat: async chat (send_message_async) is not converted; use client.aio.chats by hand
finding.history-format: chat history is not a literal list of dicts; google-genai needs {"text": ...} parts, so check it by hand
finding.files-api: file upload/management API has no automatic conversion; the whole file is left unchanged
finding.caches-api: context caching API has no automatic conversion; the whole file is left unchanged
finding.tuning-api: tuning API has no automatic conversion; the whole file is left unchanged
finding.unsupported-api: old-SDK API without automatic conversion; the whole file is left unchanged
finding.configure-args: configure()/vertexai.init() has arguments that google-genai.Client does not take over; left unchanged
finding.configure-scope: configure()/vertexai.init() must be one top-level statement; left unchanged
finding.mixed-sdk: the file uses both the Developer API SDK and the Vertex AI SDK; split it before migrating
finding.import-scope: old-SDK import is not at the top level of the module; left unchanged
finding.legacy-api: an old-SDK call is still left after the conversion; left unchanged
finding.response-shape: converted, but the response object changed: embed_content now returns .embeddings[i].values instead of ['embedding']
finding.dynamic-model: the model name is not a string literal; it was moved as is, check that it is a valid google-genai model name
